acceptance_criteria.text: A caller can sign up, sign in and sign out; invalid sign-up input, duplicate emails (case-insensitive) and bad credentials return 4xx with a JSON message, and a signed-out session stops working.
Every list and item route returns 401 and changes nothing when there is no valid session.
A second user gets 404 when reading, changing or deleting the first user's lists or items, and never sees them in list results.
Lists and items can be created, renamed or edited, ticked and unticked, and deleted; deleting a list deletes its items; items are returned in saved order.
An item is reported overdue only when its due date is before today (UTC) and it is not done; an item due today is not overdue.
Moving an item keeps positions gap-free with other items in relative order, and the order persists after the database is reopened.
Invalid input (empty or over-long text, impossible dates, bad positions) returns 4xx with a JSON message and changes nothing.
The README documents a single command to start the service locally and a single command to run the tests, and both work on a fresh clone with no external services.
